words.gloss: even if I think of him

literal: However much [I] think [of him], [he] does not get angry; is that not indeed the special favor that [my] lover does [for me]?
translation: However much I think of him, he does not get angry; is that not indeed the special favor my beloved does for me?
modern: நான் எவ்வளவு நினைத்தாலும் என் காதலர் என் மீது கோபப்பட மாட்டார்; அதுவே அவர் எனக்குச் செய்யும் சிறந்த அன்பு அல்லவா?
explanation: In this couplet, the heroine, enduring the pain of separation, finds comfort in her thoughts of her beloved. She notes that no matter how constantly or intensely she thinks of him, he never grows angry or annoyed at being summoned in her mind. She perceives this enduring sweetness and lack of resentment in her thoughts as a special act of kindness and favor from her lover. The word 'kāyār' (does not get angry) highlights the gentle nature of the beloved, who remains a source of comfort rather than irritation, even when her mind is entirely consumed by him.
